title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 92 (Hemlock Valley)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Hemlock Valley
92 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 2-19 contained within the following described boundaries: Commencing at the point of intersection of the midline of Weaver Creek Road and the midline of Hemlock Valley Recreation Area Road; thence in a general northerly direction along the midline of Hemlock Valley Recreation Area Road to the point of intersection with the midline of Sakwi Creek at 840 m elevation and including all intervening territory for 50 m on either side of the midline of said road; thence in a general northerly direction along the midline of said road to Hemlock Valley Recreation Area and including all intervening territory for 150 m on either side of the midline of said road. [en. B.C. Reg. 162/87, s. 28; am. B.C. Reg. 459/90, s. 2.]
